headline: Near Bulgaria: Analyst Attributes 21 Black Sea Ship Attacks to Russia
summary: Ambrey Analytics analyst Thomas Alexa said Russian forces likely carried out 21 of 22 attacks on vessels near Bulgaria, Romania and the Danube Delta ports. He said the aim was to disrupt Ukrainian grain exports.
why: Attacks on shipping in the Black Sea disrupt grain and agricultural cargo flows and raise insurance and freight costs for the region.
